name: LYNKUET
indications_original: LYNKUET is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms (VMS) due to menopause.
contraindications_original: The recommended dosage is 120 mg (two 60 mg capsules) orally once daily at bedtime with or without food. ( 2.2 ) Swallow capsules whole. Do not cut, crush, or chew capsules. ( 2.2 ) See full prescribing information for LYNKUET dosage modification due to drug interactions. ( 2.3 )
adverseReactions_original: LYNKUET is contraindicated in pregnancy. Exposure to LYNKUET may cause pregnancy loss or stillbirth when administered during pregnancy [see Use in Specific Populations (8.1, 8.3)].
